main_body: A fenced farm plot: a wooden post-and-rail fence enclosing a field of wheat, grass, soil rows and cabbages, drawn mostly as a flat ground patch viewed from above.
top_band: none as a distinct band. The x=56 column runs through the back rail, with rails at rows 1-5 in light-to-mid brown and the dark underside at rows 6-13, then goes straight into the crop field. No lighter horizontal surface sits above a separate front face.
evidence: The main body is the crop field, a flat plan view of planted rows with no front face. The fence posts and rails are drawn in elevation, with only a thin highlight on the rail tops, and the side rails are flat vertical strips. The frame's horizontal beams show no top faces, and nothing shows a top band over a front face as the 3/4 contract needs. It reads as a top-down plan.
